text: Form PF's systemic risk disclosure obligations were created, in a non-bankruptcy context, precisely to counteract the kind of shadow activity that is now resurfacing in bankruptcy under Revised Rule 2019.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2348463

isBasedOn.name: Hedge Funds’ Systemic Risk Disclosures in Bankruptcy

abstract: Systemic risk disclosure obligations in Form PF were created, albeit in a different context than bankruptcy, to circumvent the very shadow activities that appear to be resurfacing in the bankruptcy context under Revised Rule 2019.
